title: A compilation is one theme, four equal cases
text: The title card names the theme; each case gets about the same time (19-24 % of its source); the hook is the single strongest confrontation; each case opens on its premise and ends on a button; cases in source order (HKS-C12); 2-5 s of source under the case card. Footage fitted to the width with blur boxes on logos; glitch + Invert at every edge; quieter sources (> ~5 LU) raised +3 dB, capped at -1 dBTP (agent, EP.168).
